title: DuET: Note-Frame Dual Encoding for Piano Performance-to-Score Transcription
abstract: arXiv:2610.21467v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Transcribing expressive piano performances into scores requires interpreting individual note timings within an underlying metrical structure. However, score attributes are associated with notes, whereas beats may occur without coincident note onsets. We introduce DuET, a Dual-Encoder Transformer that jointly learns note-level performance MIDI-to-score (PM2S) transcription and frame-level beat and downbeat tracking. Bidirectional cross-attention connects note and frame encoders, while an autoregressive decoder alternates between their representations to predict structured score attributes. We further introduce TimeRoPE and Time-Pitch Rotary Positional Encoding (TPRoPE) to establish a shared performance-time reference and explicitly encode relative temporal and pitch relationships. translated_title: DuET：面向钢琴演奏转乐谱的音符-帧双重编码
translated_abstract: 将富有表现力的钢琴演奏转录为乐谱，需要在潜在的节拍结构内解释单个音符的时值。然而，乐谱属性与音符相关联，而节拍可能在不与音符起始位置重合的情况下出现。我们提出了DuET，一个双编码器Transformer，它联合学习音符级的演奏MIDI到乐谱（PM2S）转录和帧级的节拍与强拍跟踪。双向交叉注意力连接音符编码器和帧编码器，同时自回归解码器在两者的表示之间交替，以预测结构化的乐谱属性。我们进一步引入TimeRoPE和时间-音高旋转位置编码（TPRoPE），以建立共享的演奏时间参考，并显式编码相对的时间与音高关系。在古典钢琴数据集ASAP以及我们策划的、涵盖多种流派并侧重流行钢琴音乐的Gangqinpu数据集上的评估表明……
tldr: 提出DuET双编码器Transformer，通过音符与帧的双向交叉注意力及TimeRoPE、TPRoPE位置编码，将音符级钢琴MIDI转谱与帧级节拍跟踪联合建模，提升多种钢琴流派的乐谱转录效果。
en_tdlr: DuET is a dual-encoder Transformer that jointly performs note-level piano MIDI-to-score transcription and frame-level beat/downbeat tracking, leveraging bidirectional cross-attention along with TimeRoPE and Time-Pitch Rotary Positional Encoding to capture temporal and pitch relationships across classical and popular piano music.
